title: Domain concurrency — version conflict absorbed by internal retry
description: A client message and a block message for the same GUID are sent back-to-back so they may be picked up in the same Lambda batch or in overlapping executions. Both Lambdas read version=0 (item absent) or the same version and race to write. The optimistic locking retry loop inside the Lambda must absorb the conflict and ensure both domains end up written correctly.

expect.outcome: success — both messages written; at least one internal retry expected
expect.note: The script should send both messages to their respective queues as close together as possible. The final version value will be 2 or 3 depending on which write hit a conflict and retried. The important assertion is that all fields from both domains are present.
